nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) balanceOf tracking token balances of holders.
Public string name = 'PORTUGAL_WINS'.
Public string symbol = 'PORWII'.
Public uint8 decimals = 18.
Public uint256 totalSupply = 290684095692201000000000000, minted to deployer.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowance.
Constructor (named SimpleERC20Token) that assigns totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender] and emits Transfer.
transfer(address to, uint256 value): checks sender balance and moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to'.
approve(address spender, uint256 value): sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): moves tokens using allowance, deducting balanceOf[from] and allowance[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender-authorization key.
balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply assignment in constructor (unchecked initialization write).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic on user-controlled value.
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic with attacker-controlled recipient and value.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value in approve; unvalidated write of user-controlled spender and value.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on caller-supplied 'from' and 'value'.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on caller-supplied 'to' and 'value'.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on caller-supplied allowance state.
Parameter 'to' of transfer (recipient address).
Parameter 'value' of transfer (amount to move).
Parameter 'spender' of approve (address granted allowance).
Parameter 'value' of approve (allowance amount).
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom (source address).
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom (destination address).
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom (amount to move).
